data.body: SAFETY REQUIREMENT (user-raised, concurrent active session). Live check: an active sprint runs in worktree-20260528-165839 (.sprint-active marker present). The branch the user named (worktree-20260528-085216) is checked out at path worktree-20260527-171753 (branch!=dir name) and is currently KEEP via 3 gates: not-merged + age 0.1h + dirty(real handoff docs). GAP FOUND: is_claude_active() (worktree-cleanup.sh:356) only checks live-PID .claude-session.lock + lsof cwd; it does NOT honor .sprint-active/.debug-active markers. ADD Axis 5: treat .sprint-active AND .debug-active (and a live .claude-session.lock) as an ABSOLUTE KEEP guard, evaluated FIRST (before merged/clean/age and before Axis-3 scratch-relaxation), so an active sprint/debug worktree can NEVER be reclaimed regardless of merged/clean/age. Test: merged+clean+old worktree WITH .sprint-active -> KEEP. NO worktree names hardcoded anywhere — protection is gate-based. Destructive 'clean existing' step is GATED behind a --dry-run review the user must confirm; abort if any active-marked/dirty/unmerged/recent worktree shows 'remove'.
